Create split #1 (50/50, two recipients)

Pay 1.00 USDC into split #1 with payNative (one transaction, native USDC)

Create split #1

payNative 0.3 USDC to split #1

payNative with a non-whole amount (1e12+1 wei): reverts NativeAmountNotWhole

Control: native send of 0.000001 USDC to an EOA with exactly 21000 gas

sweep split #1 (moves 1 micro-USDC, 5 wei stay)
Create split #2 (nested recipient Split #1)
Pay 0.5 from the Pay card (payNative: one plain USDC transfer)
Pay 0.25 after declining native: payWithPermit
Pay 0.25 after declining native: USDC approve
Pay 0.25 after declining native: pay
Pay 0.1 on a contract without payNative: automatic fallback to payWithPermit

A claim on split #2 (auto-sweeps the native Send, pays 0.7)
